mapper.sql: select achievement_id as "achievementId", management_no as "managementNo", evaluation_year as "evaluationYear", teacher_user_id as "teacherUserId", teacher_name as "teacherName", management_item_code as "managementItemCode", occurred_date as "occurredDate", certification_status as "certificationStatus", (attachment_ref is not null) as "hasAttachment" from lecture_evaluation_achievements
mapper.select: order by occurred_date desc, achievement_id desc limit #{criteria.limit} offset #{criteria.offset}
mapper.insert: insert into lecture_evaluation_achievements (management_no, evaluation_year, teacher_user_id, teacher_name, management_item_code, occurred_date, achievement_detail, certification_status, created_by, updated_by) values (#{managementNo}, #{evaluationYear}, #{teacherUserId}, #{teacherName}, #{managementItemCode}, #{occurredDate}, cast(#{achievementDetail} as jsonb), 'DRAFTING', #{userId}, #{userId})
mapper.select: where achievement_id = #{achievementId} and deleted_yn = 'N' for update
mapper.update: update lecture_evaluation_achievements set certification_status = #{certificationStatus}, updated_by = #{userId}, updated_at = current_timestamp where achievement_id = #{achievementId}
mapper.insert: insert into education_achievement_status_histories (achievement_type, achievement_id, next_status, action_type, processed_by) values ('LECTURE_EVALUATION', #{achievementId}, 'DRAFTING', 'CREATE', #{userId})

insert into education_achievement_status_histories (achievement_type, achievement_id, previous_status, next_status, action_type, reason_code, opinion, processed_by) values ('LECTURE_EVALUATION', #{achievementId}, #{previousStatus}, #{nextStatus}, #{actionType}, #{reasonCode}, #{opinion}, #{userId})

insert into data_change_histories (target_business, target_key, change_type, field_name, after_value, changed_by, change_reason, request_id) values ('lecture_evaluation_achievements', cast(#{achievementId} as text), 'CREATE', 'certification_status', 'DRAFTING', #{userId}, '강의평가 실적 등록', #{requestId})
